entries.migration_impact: Corrupt or truncated JSON under .agentic/pm/queue.json, .agentic/fleet/handoffs.json, or .agentic/scheduled_ops/runs.json now raises CorruptStateError instead of being silently reset; repair or remove the file before resuming writes.
entries.agent_notes: Use plate_core.state_store.locked_json for new durable JSON stores; do not swallow JSONDecodeError on load. Epic #1383 / issue #1368 remaining modules migrate separately.
migration_guidance: 2. If CLI or MCP errors with CorruptStateError on these paths, inspect the JSON file and restore from backup or delete to recreate an empty store.
3. Follow-up PRs will migrate remaining .agentic writers listed in issue #1368.

entries.migration_impact: Task YAML with multi-step or mismatched escalation.from must be corrected before validate passes. Hosts may call next_run_state and persist run state before each model invocation.
entries.agent_notes: Validate .agentic/tasks with gh plate tasks validate; escalation.to must be exactly one tier above start_tier. Use next_run_state human_escalation_approved for the T3 gate; terminal states are idempotent. Record tier_step start|escalated on spend intervals when piloting crews.

entries.migration_impact: Repositories may accumulate ignored .agentic/events/ files locally; no template migration required.
entries.agent_notes: Uses state_store.locked_json (#1368) for seq; concurrent appends use dedicated .jsonl.lock. Part of epic #1383.

entries.migration_impact: Optional new ``leases:`` block in ``.agentic/process.yml``; omitting it is fine — code merges the same defaults (adapter local, ttl_s 600, grace_s 60, no_capacity_deadline 6h, revocations_before_human 3).
entries.agent_notes: Lull hub adapter remains out of scope (#1431). Max overrun after failed renew documented as ttl/3 + grace_s via max_lease_runover_seconds.

entries.migration_impact: Release finalization and release.yml now move standing release branches via non-force fast-forward. Admin force-with-lease reset requires gh plate release finalize --force-hard-reset --apply.
entries.agent_notes: Automatic path never force-pushes release branches. Stop-on-first-block when a branch diverged from the tag; inspect blocked.unshipped_commits in the helper result.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate_core and sync release.yml from upstream.

2. If branch rulesets block direct pushes to standing release branches, add your lifecycle GitHub App (secrets PLATE_APP_ID + PLATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY) as a ruleset bypass actor with Always allow, or grant github-actions bypass on org repos where policy allows.
3. Re-run gh plate release finalize <ver> --apply to repair a missed fast-forward; use --force-hard-reset --apply only for explicit admin recovery.

entries.migration_impact: Adopters need both App secrets and ruleset bypass for automated FF on user-owned repos, or accept manual/admin finalize; org repos may use github-actions bypass instead.
entries.agent_notes: Unit tests parse release.yml (repo + template_payload) for the FF job. End-to-end App token minting is not exercised in CI.
migration_guidance: 1. Install a GitHub App on the repo with Contents, Issues, Pull requests, Actions, and Checks permissions; add PLATE_APP_ID and PLATE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY repository secrets.
2. Add the App as an Always-allow bypass actor on the standing release-branch ruleset (or grant github-actions bypass where policy allows).
3. Without both secrets the workflow warns and skips the push; use gh plate release finalize or manual git fast-forward.

entries.surface: plate-pr-gates, plate_core.pr_gates_checks, release cut/finalize, gh plate release status
entries.migration_impact: Regenerate or import plate-pr-gates.yml. Sync labels including release-window:open and release-window-override. Release cut (non-dry-run) applies release-window:open on the Next Release issue; finalize runs set_next_release_release_window_open(False) before ensure_next_release_issue so the new standing issue starts with Release only.
entries.agent_notes: gh plate release status reports release_window_open. Use release-window-override only for approver-sanctioned exceptions (#1439).

entries.migration_impact: Downstream repos: expect stricter issue label-check (at most one status:*). Unblock workflow no longer promotes Features that already violate multi-status. Integration merge no longer adds status:implemented to Epic/Task/Release issues referenced by Closes; ensure those types use their ceremony or rely on GitHub default-branch close. Pure-push merges to release branches no longer trigger mark-implemented (merge the PR instead).
entries.agent_notes: Import shared rules from plate_core.issue_status_lifecycle in tools/tests; integration behavior is documented in AGENTS.md Label Rules.

entries.migration_impact: Adopters receive the new on-demand page via import-payload or self-migrate. No renames of existing migrations; no CI enforcement.
entries.agent_notes: Before adding a schema migration, load docs/agents/database-migration-naming.md. Default to YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ_short_slug.ext at creation time. Keep sequential numbering only when the toolchain forces it and document that exception in the repo. Never rename existing migration files.
migration_guidance: 1. Refresh AGENTS.md and docs/agents/ from PLATE import-payload or self-migrate when convenient.
2. Teach agents (and humans) the timestamp slug convention for all new migrations.
3. If your migration tool requires numeric ordering, state that in README, SPEC.md, or docs/migration/ instead of silently using sequential names.

entries.surface: plate-pr-gates main-source check, plate_core.pr_gates_checks, gh plate pr preflight
entries.migration_impact: After upgrade, Feature/Bug/Documentation PRs must target a release integration branch (see gh plate release status). Regenerate or import plate-pr-gates.yml. Add the main-source-override label for rare exceptions.
entries.agent_notes: Run gh plate pr preflight before gh pr create --base main. Release PRs use release or release-v* heads. Infrastructure PRs to main need an approver to apply main-source-override until lifecycle approvers (#1425) restrict the label.

entries.surface: gh plate pr preflight/create, plate_core.pr_gates_checks, plate-pr-gates failure text
entries.migration_impact: Agents should prefer `gh plate pr create` or run `gh plate pr preflight` before opening PRs. Adopters import regenerated plate-pr-gates.yml when syncing payload.
entries.agent_notes: Run `gh plate pr preflight --body-file body.md --base release --labels Feature,area:cli` (or `gh plate pr create -- …`) before spending tokens on CI fix-ups. Shared checks live in plate_core.pr_gates_checks.
